summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests radiation therapy given after starting immunotherapy, before surgery, for sinonasal or anorectal mucosal melanoma. Patients receive combination immunotherapy, such as ipilimumab and nivolumab or nivolumab and relatlimab, followed by radiation therapy in 5, 15 or 20 fractions depending on the group, and then surgery or biopsy. The record does not state a main outcome measure; its stated goal is to learn whether this approach helps patients have better outcomes.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa la radioterapia administrada después de iniciar la inmunoterapia, y antes de la cirugía, para el melanoma de mucosa sinonasal o anorrectal. Los pacientes reciben inmunoterapia combinada, como ipilimumab y nivolumab o nivolumab y relatlimab, seguida de radioterapia en 5, 15 o 20 fracciones según el grupo, y luego cirugía o biopsia. El registro no indica una medida de resultado principal; su objetivo declarado es saber si este enfoque ayuda a que los pacientes tengan mejores resultados.
who_for: Melanoma of the nasal cavity, sinuses, or anorectal canal, confirmed by biopsy or cytology
Mucosal tumor seen on clinical exam or imaging
Planned for combination immunotherapy such as ipilimumab and nivolumab
Age 18 or older, with ECOG performance status 3 or less
not_for: Previous radiation therapy to the planned target area
Unwilling to use adequate contraception during the study
